frozen_claims.text: iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā — so far directly Śiva maker.
aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati — impure path Aghoreśa-Ananta emits.
īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham — by Lord's will, for wavered atoms' enjoyment-perfection.
Aghoreśa-Ananta emits the impure path for craving atoms.
tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti — waverer, incomplete, other-natured throbbing, mere longing, future fitness for bounding.
na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram — not man's impurity nor another category.
Craving = mere longing, not impurity, no new category.
